---
title: "Export Controls"
subtitle: "US export-control and military-linked designations across tracked facilities and firms"
date: last-modified
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/helpers.R")
library(DT)
library(dplyr)

facilities <- load_facilities("data/facilities.yml")
design <- load_design_firms("data/design.yml")
materials <- load_materials_firms("data/materials.yml")
```

## Overview

As of `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")`: **`r sum(facilities$entity_list_flagged)`** of `r nrow(facilities)` tracked facilities, **`r sum(design$entity_list_flagged)`** of `r nrow(design)` design firms, and **`r sum(materials$entity_list_flagged)`** of `r nrow(materials)` equipment/materials firms carry a US export-control or military-linked designation — most on the Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) Entity List, one (CXMT) on the Department of Defense's separate Section 1260H list of Chinese military-linked companies. The two lists carry different legal consequences (Entity List restricts exports; 1260H is a disclosure/reputational designation) — see the List column below for which applies to each entry.

## Flagged Entries

```{r table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
fac_rows <- facilities %>% filter(entity_list_flagged) %>%
  transmute(Name = name_en, Type = "Facility", "Date Added" = format(entity_list_date, "%b %Y"), List = entity_list_name)
design_rows <- design %>% filter(entity_list_flagged) %>%
  transmute(Name = name_en, Type = "Design Firm", "Date Added" = format(entity_list_date, "%b %Y"), List = entity_list_name)
materials_rows <- materials %>% filter(entity_list_flagged) %>%
  transmute(Name = name_en, Type = "Equipment/Materials Firm", "Date Added" = format(entity_list_date, "%b %Y"), List = entity_list_name)

all_flagged <- bind_rows(fac_rows, design_rows, materials_rows)

if (nrow(all_flagged) > 0) {
  datatable(all_flagged, options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftip"), rownames = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("*No entries flagged yet.*")
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Non-Partisan Note
Entity List and Section 1260H status are factual designations by US government agencies (Commerce Department BIS and Department of Defense respectively). Their inclusion here documents export-control and reputational exposure, not a judgement on the underlying US or Chinese policy.
:::
